steps.text: What can you help me with?
steps.response:
I'm GitHub Copilot CLI — your AI-powered terminal assistant! Here's what I can do:

• **Write & edit code** — generate functions, refactor files, fix bugs
• **Explain code** — break down complex logic in plain language
• **Run commands** — execute shell commands, builds, and tests
• **Search your codebase** — find files, symbols, and patterns
• **Git workflows** — create commits, branches, and pull requests
• **Debug issues** — analyze errors and suggest fixes

Just describe what you need in natural language, and I'll take care of the rest!
